descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

This API operation supports a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, rate limiting is triggered, which may affect your application. Call the API only as needed.
